_note: Curated (T2c). Q (BaseDamage = EffectValueCalculationPart + StatByNamedDataValueCalculationPart), W (BaseDamage, EffectValueCalculationPart + StatByCoefficientCalculationPart) and E (TotalDamage, EffectValueCalculationPart + StatByCoefficientCalculationPart) all use CalculationPart kinds FormulaInterpreter fully supports, so these resolve live (verified against FormulaInterpreter.cs's EvaluatePart switch). R (Void Assault) is a stealth with no damage. Q's isolation bonus (a x2.1 GameCalculationModified named 'IsoDamage') is not modeled -- isolation targeting is not tracked by the engine, and it's a conditional multiplier on Q rather than a separate proc, so it doesn't cleanly fit the P/bonusEffects schema.
_noteP: P (Unseen Threat) — §11.E fix (loop 106): TYPE and mechanic corrected. The earlier note called this 'Taste Their Fear ... TRUE damage to isolated enemies' — WRONG on both counts. wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kha'Zix confirms this calc is UNSEEN THREAT (the passive): while Kha'Zix is unseen, his next basic attack deals '17-136 (based on level) (+50% bonus AD) bonus MAGIC damage' — an exact match to this calc (KhazixPassive.mSpellCalculations 'TotalDamage' = ByCharLevelFormulaCalculationPart(BIN field 'values' = [10,17,24,...,220], 31 entries, step +7 -> values[1]=17, values[18]=136) + StatByNamedDataValueCalculationPart(mStat=2/mStatFormula=2, mDataValue='BonusADRatio', flat 0.5 = 50% bonus AD)). Type is MAGIC, NOT true (true would wrongly bypass MR). TRIGGER CAVEAT: Unseen Threat only arms while Kha'Zix is UNSEEN (after R Void Assault, or from brush/vision-loss), not every attack — but 'unseen' is not a tracked live state, so it stays modeled as an always-on P on-hit (an engage upper bound, same spirit as the fully-realized-combo convention; over-states a stand-still auto-trade). It is genuinely the passive, so it correctly lives under P (the calc resolves in KhazixPassive). RESOLVED: ByCharLevelFormulaCalculationPart is now parsed/evaluated (new CalculationPart.Kind.ByCharLevelFormula; FormulaInterpreter indexes 'values' directly by champion level, index 0 unused -- same convention verified against Leona's passive). Level 1 = values[1] (17) + 0.5*bonusAD; level 18 = values[18] (136) + 0.5*bonusAD. Hand-verified in ChampionBinTests.FormulaInterpreter_Evaluate_KhazixPassive_ResolvesByCharLevelFormulaPlusBonusADRatio. Modeled as a P bonusEffect trigger onHit (same conditional-proc style as Sejuani/Volibear/Nocturne P); isolation is not tracked by the engine so this always applies now that the interpreter can evaluate it.
_noteQ: Q (Taste Their Fear) — M25 §11.G VsIsolated conditional (loop 106). BIN 'BaseDamage' = base physical (grouped target; EffectValue(1) + bonusAD). 'IsoDamage' = GameCalculationModified(BaseDamage x 2.1) — the ISOLATED value (wiki: '210% against Isolated targets'), the x2.1 a BIN NumberPart (BIN-sourced, not hardcoded). Isolation is NOT exposed by the Live Client API -> VsIsolated is UserAssumed: calc:BaseDamage is the UNMET grouped anchor (conservative RangeMin, preserves the prior resolved number), metCalc:IsoDamage is the MET/isolated end (RangeMax). The UserConditionMet knob defaults unmet; the exposure-graph spans [grouped, isolated]. Finally models the isolation bonus the prior note flagged 'not modeled' (it resolves fine once EffectAmounts are loaded, which the real ChampionRepository does).
